# Alibaba Cloud DNS
> Alibaba Cloud DNS provides managed authoritative DNS, recursive DNS, and traffic management services for domain resolution.

Alibaba Cloud DNS documentation covers public authoritative DNS, private DNS, DNS security, traffic scheduling, API usage, SDK integration, and operational guides across Alibaba Cloud products.

## Product Overview
- [Alibaba Cloud DNS Product Page](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/dns): Overview of managed DNS capabilities, features, and deployment scenarios.
- [Alibaba Cloud DNS Documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns): Central documentation hub for Alibaba Cloud DNS products and features.
- [Alibaba Cloud DNS Pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/dns/pricing): Pricing information for DNS editions and related service capabilities.
- [What is Alibaba Cloud DNS?](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/product-overview/what-is-alibaba-cloud-dns): Introduction to Alibaba Cloud DNS architecture, use cases, and core functions.

## Getting Started
- [Quick Start](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/getting-started): Entry point for initial DNS setup and service onboarding tasks.
- [Activate Alibaba Cloud DNS](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/getting-started/activate-alibaba-cloud-dns): Steps to enable the service and begin managing DNS zones.
- [Add a Domain Name](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/getting-started/add-a-domain-name): Instructions for adding a domain and preparing it for resolution.
- [Configure DNS Records](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/getting-started/configure-dns-records): Basic record management workflow for common DNS record types.
- [Change DNS Servers](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/getting-started/change-dns-servers): Guidance for updating registrar nameserver settings to Alibaba Cloud DNS.

## User Guide
- [Manage DNS Records](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/manage-dns-records): Procedures for creating, editing, and deleting DNS records.
- [DNS Record Types](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/dns-record-types): Reference for supported record types and their intended usage.
- [Line-based DNS](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/line-based-dns): Configure routing by ISP line or geographic resolution policies.
- [TTL Settings](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/ttl-settings): Explanation of TTL behavior and operational tradeoffs for caching.
- [Subdomain Management](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/subdomain-management): Organize and delegate subdomains within managed DNS zones.
- [Batch Operations](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/batch-operations): Perform bulk DNS changes efficiently across records and domains.

## Traffic Management and Advanced DNS
- [Intelligent DNS Resolution](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/intelligent-dns-resolution): Route users based on network line, region, or policy conditions.
- [Failover and Disaster Recovery](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/failover-and-disaster-recovery): Improve availability with DNS-based failover and recovery strategies.
- [Weighted Round Robin](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/weighted-round-robin): Distribute traffic across endpoints using weighted DNS responses.
- [URL Forwarding](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/url-forwarding): Redirect requests at the DNS service layer for supported scenarios.
- [Secondary DNS](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/user-guide/secondary-dns): Configure secondary DNS synchronization and redundancy options.

## Private DNS
- [Private DNS Overview](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/private-dns): Documentation hub for private DNS in VPC environments.
- [What is Private DNS?](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/private-dns/product-overview/what-is-private-dns): Overview of private zone resolution for internal cloud networks.
- [Create a Private Zone](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/private-dns/getting-started/create-a-private-zone): Set up internal DNS zones for VPC-based name resolution.
- [Associate a VPC](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/private-dns/user-guide/associate-a-vpc): Bind private DNS zones to one or more VPCs.
- [Private Zone Records](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/private-dns/user-guide/private-zone-records): Manage internal DNS records for private service discovery.
- [Private DNS Best Practices](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/private-dns/best-practices): Recommendations for scalable and reliable internal DNS design.

## API Reference
- [API Overview](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-overview): Introduction to Alibaba Cloud DNS OpenAPI usage and authentication.
- [API Reference](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-reference): Complete reference for DNS operations, parameters, and responses.
- [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-reference/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains): List managed domains and related metadata through the API.
- [DescribeDomainRecords](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-reference/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords): Query DNS records for a specified domain name.
- [AddDomainRecord](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-reference/api-alidns-2015-01-09-adddomainrecord): Create a new DNS record in a managed zone.
- [UpdateDomainRecord](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-reference/api-alidns-2015-01-09-updatedomainrecord): Modify an existing DNS record through the OpenAPI.
- [DeleteDomainRecord](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-reference/api-alidns-2015-01-09-deletedomainrecord): Remove a DNS record from a managed domain.

## SDKs and Developer Tools
- [Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI Explorer](https://api.aliyun.com/product/Alidns): Interactive console for testing Alibaba Cloud DNS API operations.
- [Alibaba Cloud SDK Overview](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sdk): Entry point for SDK documentation across supported languages.
- [Python SDK](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sdk/developer-reference/python): Use the Python SDK to call Alibaba Cloud APIs.
- [Java SDK](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sdk/developer-reference/java): Use the Java SDK for DNS automation and integration.
- [Go SDK](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sdk/developer-reference/go): Use the Go SDK to build DNS management tooling.
- [Node.js SDK](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sdk/developer-reference/node-js): Use the Node.js SDK for programmatic DNS operations.
- [CLI Overview](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cli): Command-line tooling for managing Alibaba Cloud resources.

## Operations and Best Practices
- [Best Practices](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/best-practices): Curated operational recommendations for DNS reliability and governance.
- [DNS Security Best Practices](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/best-practices/dns-security-best-practices): Guidance for protecting domains and reducing DNS attack exposure.
- [High Availability Architecture](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/best-practices/high-availability-architecture): Design patterns for resilient DNS deployments and failover.
- [Migration to Alibaba Cloud DNS](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/best-practices/migration-to-alibaba-cloud-dns): Plan and execute migration from another DNS provider.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/troubleshooting): Resolve common DNS configuration, propagation, and resolution issues.
- [FAQ](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/faq): Answers to common questions about features, limits, and operations.

## Related Services
- [Domain Names](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/domain): Domain registration and lifecycle management on Alibaba Cloud.
- [Anti-DDoS](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/anti-ddos): DDoS protection services that complement DNS and edge availability.
- [Web Application Firewall](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/waf): Application-layer protection for web properties behind DNS endpoints.
- [Global Traffic Manager](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/global-traffic-manager): Global traffic steering and health-aware routing for distributed services.
- [Server Load Balancer](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/server-load-balancer): Load balancing service commonly paired with DNS-based traffic distribution.
- [CDN](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/cdn): Content delivery service integrated with domain acceleration and DNS workflows.
